card_unit: A: object_id x sensor_type (unit B is not evaluated in v3)

not_trained.0600: branch A: labels/features at 06:00 exist in artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/v3_prep; not trained because the untrained references showed no gain (persistence dP -0.003 [-0.012; +0.007]) while the median lead drops from 11 to 6 h; night activity of the object is visible for about 4% of events

policies.days_off: Saturday and Sunday of the issue day; public holidays are NOT applied: the repository has no verified production calendar

fold_note: as v2: cutoffs whose horizon window crosses the fit/evaluate boundary are dropped from fit (embargo = horizon)
fit_rows: as v2: candidate rows with a known label, all positives plus negatives with sha256('sensor-failure-model-v1:' + channel_id + ':' + issued_at) mod 100 < 10, weighted 10 before Balanced weighting

references.persistence: hours since the last candidate of the label (ascending), ties by episode starts in 30 days; card = max over candidate channels
references.static_list: point-in-time static list of last year: target events of the object x sensor type known before the cutoff within the previous 365 days (sensor_failure_evaluation.static_list_scores)
references.ceiling: perfect ranking under the same policy (greedy oracle, upper reference)

candidates.why_these_configs: the three best v2 configurations at 24 h on the development folds (best F2/mean_top2/model_only mean P@2 0.167 c3, 0.166 c1, 0.164 c5); depth 8 (c2, c4) and depth 4 (c0) were lower (<= 0.162) and the spread between all six (0.008) is below the thread-count noise (about 0.02)
candidates.why_fixed_aggregation: v2 at 24 h: mean_top2 model_only was best for every feature set (mean over configs F2 0.157 vs max 0.143 vs noisy-OR 0.108)

hygiene.thread_count: fixed 6 in catboost_fixed; the run records thread_count, os.cpu_count() and the CPU model in cv.json and in the report
hygiene.seed_noise: each configuration is fitted with seeds 17, 18, 19; a metric is the mean over seeds of the fold means; seed spread = max - min over seeds of the fold-mean metric
hygiene.tie_rule: two candidates tie if the difference of their seed means is smaller than the larger of their two seed spreads; a tie goes to the simpler candidate (2 per day before the calendar budget; configurations c1 < c5 < c3 by fit cost)
hygiene.seed_ensemble: bootstrap intervals use the seed ensemble: the mean of the three seeds' card scores

selection.configuration: under the main v2 budget (2 per day): the configuration with the highest seed-mean card precision subject to seed-mean event recall >= persistence recall - 0.02; configurations tying with the best (tie rule) go to the simplest
selection.weekly_ci: 95% week-block bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 17) on the pooled evaluation years 2023-2024 with bootstrap_variant_deltas (cards by ISO week of the cutoff, events by ISO week of the start)

C_calendar_policy.primary: the selected configuration under 2/1 has higher seed-mean card precision than under 2/2 (not a tie) AND its seed-mean event recall under 2/1 >= persistence recall under 2/2 - 0.02
C_calendar_policy.static_list: the selected configuration has higher card precision than the static list under the same policy, week-block CI lower bound of the difference > 0 (seed ensemble), for both policies
C_calendar_policy.reported: weekly CI of 2/1 - 2/2 for the model and both references; model vs persistence; ceilings; cards per working day and per day off; per configuration mean and spread over seeds on each fold

criteria.failure: if C fails the budget stays 2 per day; the result is reported as is

mlflow.run_layout: one run per fit (fold x configuration x seed) with the model and its fold metrics under both policies; one run per configuration with seed means/spreads; reference runs per fold and policy; the experiment is created before the run

outputs: artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/tuning_v3/ (cv.json, card scores with identifiers stay there); aggregated report reports/sensor-failure-tuning-v3-cv-2026-09-26.json

final.status: not implemented and not run in this step
final.period: a new data period after 2026-06 if delivered; otherwise the holdout 2025-07..2026-06 explicitly labelled 'third use of the holdout' (first: sensor-failure-model-v1, second: sensor-failure-tuning-v2)
final.refit: selected configuration (seed ensemble) refitted on all development years; calibration on 2025 H1 as in v2; the model is saved for the inference bundle

time_budget: 3 configurations x 3 seeds x 2 folds = 18 fits (v2 F2 fits took 1-3 min on 6 threads): about 30-45 min including scoring
